lint_scripts.root: npm run lint -> node scripts/check-file-sizes.mjs && npm run check:gh-aw-versions && eslint .
lint_scripts.dashboard_site: npm run lint -> eslint . && node ./scripts/lint-octicons.mjs && npm run validate:dashboards

ci_workflows: workflow-contracts.yml (npm run check, which runs npm run lint) for root
cid.yml (lint-unit job, npm run lint) for dashboard/site, path-filtered

ignore_patterns: root eslint.config.mjs ignores: dashboard/site/**, node_modules/**, test-results/**, tests/** (tests/ dir is NOT linted by root config)
dashboard/site eslint.config.mjs ignores: node_modules/**, coverage/**, dist/**, .lazy-page-chunks-*/**
coverage.custom_rules_dir: eslint-rules/ (root) contains custom plugin no-hardcoded-github-actions-url.mjs plus its own campaign aw.yml/cao.json/rules-db.mjs

payload.adoption_readiness_reason: ESLint 9 flat config already active in both root and dashboard/site projects, CI enforces lint via npm run check and cid.yml, and root already hosts a working custom-rule pattern (eslint-rules/no-hardcoded-github-actions-url.mjs) that new rules can follow. Note root config's ignores exclude tests/** from lint, and neither project has type-aware/typescript-eslint linting configured.
